benchmarks.title: Interstellar · Gargantua Endurance Flyby
benchmarks.prompt: 复刻星际穿越中环形母船在黑洞边缘飞行的特效场面
benchmarks.promptEn: Recreate the VFX shot from Interstellar showing the ring mothership flying past the edge of a black hole (Gargantua).
benchmarks.fairnessNote: ⚠ 耗时说明：Gemini 4 Hydrogen 首轮先生成了交互式 HTML 页面（10分35秒），经用户二次纠正后才渲染交付视频（7分55秒，两轮累计 18分30秒）；而 ChatGPT 6.2 Sol Max (Codex) 单轮直接输出视频（20分18秒）。因此本次双方的生成耗时与 Token 数据没有直接对照参考性。
benchmarks.fairnessNoteEn: ⚠ Timing Disclaimer: Gemini 4 Hydrogen first built an interactive HTML scene (10m 35s) and only rendered the MP4 video after a second user prompt (7m 55s; 18m 30s combined), whereas ChatGPT 6.2 Sol Max (Codex) produced the video in one run (20m 18s). Generation time and token comparisons for this round are not directly comparable.
